notes.title: Update v1.2.6.0
notes.content: - Gamepad Input: Can now use right analog stick for directional input

notes.title: Update v1.2.5.0
notes.content:
- Updated boss music with enhanced melody

- "Challenges" renamed to "Remix Modes" and is a different color



The composer (Momentvm) enhanced the melody in the boss music when working on the OST mixes, so I requested for it to be included in the game since it sounds cool.

I noticed that the "Challenges" button under the "Standard" game mode was easily overlooked, which isn't desirable since it's where the majority of ByteRogue's content is located. I am hoping that this button looks more important now.

notes.title: Update v1.2.4.1
notes.content: - Made the controls a lot more visible

notes.title: Update v1.2.4.0
notes.content: - Updated game over screen's text to further clarify what the gems are for.

notes.title: Demo Update v1.2.2.1
notes.content:
Fixed menu music not playing correctly on game open (it was skipping the first few seconds)

More behind-the-scenes changes to prepare for full release

notes.title: Demo Update v1.2.1.1 (Spell Buffs and QoL!)
notes.content:
This update provides buffs to a couple of spells and adds some QoL. More importantly, this update is preparing the game for its full release on July 24th!



Dash and Block can now be used point-blank

Dash does nothing point-blank, but lets you throw the spell away

Block has a new secret technique when used point-blank (Try it out!)

Added clarity to Spells UI

Added tip to "How to Play" section to encourage players to figure out the game's intricacies

Changed color coding of game modes in main menu

Changed tip on last floor to defeat the boss

Lots of behind-the-scenes changes to prepare for full release

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.2.0
notes.content:
- Greatly mitigated enemies erroneously skipping their turns despite having tiles to move to (turns in this game are supposed to always be forced when able)

- Losing in a mode that you already cleared no longer shows highest floor, in its place a reminder that you need to win for gems to count for trophies

- F11 now toggles fullscreen (independent of the ingame setting)

- Function keys can no longer be bound to (reserved for possible future shortcuts)

- Further clarified Refresh Mode text

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.1.0
notes.content: Reorganized the main menu to be less cluttered

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.0.0 (Beginner Mode!)
notes.content:
I have noticed players struggling with the demo, so I decided to remedy this with a new mode to help ease in new players! Unfortunately, I also had to remove the Bomb Storage challenge mode from the demo to maintain its size. Sorry about that, but you'll be able to play it again in the full release! (If you played Bomb Storage already, its progress will carry over to the full version.)



- NEW: Beginner Mode, which has reduced starting enemies, no bad crates, and an easier boss

- Standard Mode requires a bronze trophy from Beginner Mode to unlock (stays unlocked if you already earned a trophy before this update)

- Refresh Mode now requires 2 trophies to unlock

- Removed Bomb Storage Mode from demo (Sorry, demo is getting too big!)

- Locked game modes now show their names in the menu

- Changed Refresh Mode's description to clarify the increased enemies

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.3.0
notes.content:
- Quit and Retry buttons can now also be used to deselect the current spell
- In the main menu, Action2 button now shortcuts to the Quit option instead of instantly closing the game unless the Quit option is already selected

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.2.0
notes.content:
- All input is no longer detected when game is inactive
- "Other Modes" is renamed to "Challenge Modes"
- Added a couple more enemies to "Refresh Mode" to make it slightly harder

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.1.0
notes.content:
- Added version info in main menu
- Reduced visual importance of "highest floor" stat
- Changed bomb sprite to look less like a coin
